description: Source code for handling UI assets and live reload functionality in the openclaw project, including path resolution, HTTP request handling, and injecting live reload scripts into HTML.

methods.name: resolveA2uiRoot

methods.description: Resolves and caches the real path of the A2UI root directory, with retry logic.

methods.name: handleA2uiHttpRequest
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests for A2UI assets, serving files and injecting live reload scripts.
